responsibility: Declares small utility accessors for the gm2 ISO channel subsystem that expose information hidden behind the abstract IOChan.ChanId type. It provides procedures to recover the underlying FIO.File associated with a channel and to obtain that channel’s filename as a newly allocated DynamicStrings.String, making it a narrow introspection interface used by code that needs file-oriented details without owning the broader IOChan dispatch or device-management logic.
same_name_distinction: This is the definition/interface file for IOChanUtils: it only publishes the GetFileName and GetFile procedure signatures and imported types for clients of the ISO channel utilities. Unlike the same-stem implementation module, it contains no RTio or SFIO-based channel-to-file logic.
